# LibreDWG browser fixture

`example_2018.dwg` is the upstream LibreDWG mixed-entity regression drawing:
https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg/blob/master/test/test-data/example_2018.dwg

Retrieved 2026-09-21. Upstream project: https://github.com/LibreDWG/libredwg
License: GNU GPL v3 or later (see upstream COPYING and this repository's LICENSE).
This is a parser regression sample, not a customer floor plan. Synthetic geometry
tests separately assert block transforms, curve extrema, unit scale and persistence.
